summary: Authored a 7-phase sequential implementation plan for the shared iterator's is_world assumption. Core design: three named extension points on iterate/core.py's BaseModelIterator (_pin_theory_specific_values, live-loop-reached _create_difference_constraint with a generic base-class default, _check_model_isomorphism), each behavior-preserving for logos/imposition/exclusion and overridden by BimodalModelIterator over the certificate variable set. No is_world shim. Planning surfaced two facts the research report did not: (1) the shared graph-isomorphism path produces EMPTY graphs for bimodal (z3_world_states never populated) and two empty graphs are isomorphic, so every bimodal model would be falsely skipped even after the crash and exclusion-gap fixes - promoted to in-scope as Phase 4; (2) logos's and imposition's _create_non_isomorphic_constraint/_create_stronger_constraint return z3.BoolVal(True) no-ops, so the research report's recommended replacement of ConstraintGenerator's stronger-constraint path would have removed those theories' only real escape constraint - Phase 3 composes rather than replaces. Phase 6 is an explicit decision gate against Phase 1's captured baselines with a documented contingency narrowing.

artifacts.summary: 7-phase plan: baseline/reproduction/RED test, three extension points, bimodal live green, cross-theory regression gate, docs alignment.
